# Revora (sellrepairphone.org) - Full Knowledge Base

Revora is a quality mobile repair and phone buyback service based in Mumbai, India. We specialise in reviving dead phones, micro-soldering, liquid damage recovery, and offering assured cash for pre-owned or broken devices.

## Key Services
- Instant Phone Buyback: Sell old, broken, or completely dead phones (iPhone, Samsung, etc.) for payment via UPI or bank transfer.
- Lab Bench Repair: Specialized micro-soldering for dead logic boards, data recovery, and hardware faults.
- Standard Repair: Same-day screen, battery, and camera replacements.
- Pre-Loved Flagships: Shop certified 100-point inspected refurbished iPhones and Galaxy phones with 1-year shield warranty.
- Doorstep Service: Free secure pickup and drop available across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.

## Operating Principles & Security
- 100% Data Security: We execute NIST 800-88 military-grade 3-pass hardware wipe on working phones. If dead, the memory chip is physically destroyed and recycled safely.
- OEM Level Components: We use genuine components or quality equivalents, re-vulcanize IP68 water seals, and reprogram TrueTone/battery health data.
- Turnaround Time: Most screen and battery replacements take 30-45 minutes. Micro-soldering and liquid damage recovery takes 24-48 hours.

## Booking Process
1. Quote: Customers use our online estimators (T1/T2) to get a fixed upfront price.
2. Handover: Customers can book a free doorstep pickup (courier/runner), mail it in, or walk into the lab.
3. Diagnostic: Devices undergo a 22-point diagnostic.
4. Execution: Approved work is completed by master technicians.
5. Payout / Return: Buyback payouts are instant via UPI/IMPS. Repaired devices are returned securely.
